learning_outcomes.text: Students will observe the application of the chemical engineering profession in production and business life, and learn to transfer theoretical knowledge provided in the education program to practice.
They will enrich their perspectives by becoming aware of the chemical engineering profession, its duties and responsibilities.
They will develop themselves in social issues such as professional ethics, human health, occupational safety, and environment.
They will gain knowledge about the importance of the sector they examine for our country and the world, and its working conditions.

They will grasp the importance of work discipline, teamwork, interdisciplinary cooperation, individual competencies, and human relations in businesses, work, and professional life through observation, and will complete their own deficiencies.
They will develop their verbal and written communication skills.
They will learn about quality and standardization.
They will have the opportunity to observe contemporary techniques and developments.

syllabus_topics: Learning the history of the institution, its place and function in the industry
Understanding the applied process and flowchart
Performing mass and energy balance calculations on the flowchart
Acquiring information about the function, structure, operating conditions, and maintenance of the units involved in the process
Learning the piping and instrumentation system and drawing a diagram
Learning process control and quality control mechanisms
